system.name: UAS Weapon System
system.description: The UAS Weapon System is a multi-segment intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) system composed of four operational segments with lower-level components inside each segment.

subsystems.name: UAS Air Vehicle Segment
subsystems.description: Airborne platform carrying sensor payloads and command relay functions

subsystems.name: Satellite Communications Terminal
subsystems.description: Ground relay and crypto gateway for all air-to-ground traffic

subsystems.name: Navigation Subsystem
subsystems.description: Provides position and attitude data to the mission computer

subsystems.name: Processing Subsystem
subsystems.description: Executes mission payloads and sensor fusion

subsystems.name: Encryption Gateway Subsystem
subsystems.description: Performs in-line encryption and decryption of all satellite link traffic

subsystems.name: Traffic Shaping Subsystem
subsystems.description: Controls data flow rates and priority queuing for the satellite link

subsystems.name: Diagnostic Computer Subsystem
subsystems.description: Hosts maintenance workstation software and provides the technician HMI for fault isolation and health monitoring

subsystems.name: Software Load Station Subsystem
subsystems.description: Manages storage integrity verification and transfer of authorised software loads to Alpha

subsystems.name: Test Interface Module Subsystem
subsystems.description: Physical and logical interface between the GMS and the Alpha maintenance port

components.name: Flight Control Computer
components.description: Executes autonomous flight logic and consumes navigation and maintenance inputs

components.name: Payload Controller
components.description: Manages sensor payload collection and mission-mode selection

components.name: Telemetry Router
components.description: Formats telemetry and command acknowledgements for the satellite link

components.name: Aircraft Key Store
components.description: Stores link keys and command authorization material

components.name: Mission Processing Server
components.description: Runs payload analytics and intelligence fusion jobs

components.name: Intelligence Storage Cluster
components.description: Retains mission outputs flight logs and processed intelligence

components.name: Dissemination Gateway
components.description: Publishes approved products to downstream consumers and maintenance services

components.name: Operator Analyst Workstation
components.description: Issues tasking updates and reviews processed mission results

components.name: Satcom Modem
components.description: Handles encrypted RF relay between the air vehicle and ground segments

components.name: Crypto Gateway
components.description: Performs AES-256-GCM encryption and decryption for the satellite link

components.name: Key Management Module
components.description: Maintains session keys and rotation state for the relay boundary

components.name: Maintenance Test Set
components.description: Performs diagnostic queries and validation checks on the air vehicle

components.name: Software Load Manager
components.description: Stages and transfers authenticated software packages to the air vehicle

components.name: Diagnostics Recorder
components.description: Captures HUMS data fault codes and maintenance session logs

components.name: GPS Receiver
components.description: Acquires satellite signals and outputs position fixes

components.name: Inertial Measurement Unit
components.description: Measures angular rate and acceleration

components.name: Command Processor
components.description: Parses and validates operator uplink messages

components.name: Mission Computer
components.description: Runs payload algorithms and logs results

components.name: Solid State Recorder
components.description: Records high-rate sensor data

components.name: Key Management Module
components.description: Manages encryption keys for stored data

components.name: Bulk Encryption Module
components.description: Applies AES-256-GCM encryption and decryption to satellite data frames

components.name: Key Distribution Module
components.description: Receives keying material and distributes keys to the encryption module on schedule

components.name: Traffic Shaper
components.description: Manages queuing, prioritization, and rate limiting for satellite link data

components.name: Maintenance Workstation
components.description: Technician HMI presenting BIT results fault codes calibration data and maintenance history

components.name: Maintenance Data Recorder
components.description: Encrypted local storage for all maintenance session logs BIT results and HUMS downloads

components.name: Software Load Controller
components.description: Manages software baseline for all loadable software parts and coordinates with Bravo for approved packages

components.name: Load Verification Module
components.description: Executes post-load integrity checks by reading back installed part numbers and checksums

components.name: Bus Controller
components.description: Manages MIL-STD-1553 bus master operations and schedules message transfers to Alpha LRUs

components.name: RS-422 Serial Interface
components.description: Low-speed serial channel for Alpha LRUs that do not support MIL-STD-1553

stride.S_justification: RF link allows unauthenticated spoofing of telemetry sources.
stride.T_justification: Encrypted but susceptible to bit-flip tampering under jamming.
stride.R_justification: Limited audit trail on satellite relay reduces repudiation evidence.
stride.I_justification: Sensor and health data are mission-sensitive.
stride.D_justification: Jamming or link loss disrupts critical ISR downlink.
stride.E_justification: No privilege escalation path on this interface.

threats.name: RF Telemetry Spoofing
threats.description: Adversary injects forged telemetry frames over the satellite RF link to mislead ground analysts.

mitigations_technical.title: RF Link Message Authentication
mitigations_technical.description: Implement cryptographic message authentication codes on all telemetry frames to detect and reject spoofed data.

mitigations_administrative.title: Telemetry Anomaly Response Procedure
mitigations_administrative.description: Crew procedure to validate telemetry against independent sources and initiate link failover on anomaly detection.

stride.S_justification: Spoofed uplink commands could inject malicious flight directives.
stride.T_justification: Tampering with auth tokens or waypoints risks vehicle control.
stride.D_justification: Link denial prevents real-time command authority.
stride.E_justification: Compromised token could enable elevated command privileges.

threats.name: Uplink Command Injection
threats.description: Adversary forges authenticated uplink commands to alter flight path or payload modes.

mitigations_technical.title: Command Message Signing and Replay Protection
mitigations_technical.description: Enforce digital signatures and nonce validation on all uplink commands to prevent injection and replay.

mitigations_administrative.title: Command Authorization Audit
mitigations_administrative.description: Require dual-operator authorization review for high-impact commands before transmission.

stride.S_justification: TLS mitigates spoofing but endpoint misconfiguration possible.
stride.T_justification: Decrypted frames could be altered in transit on internal net.
stride.R_justification: HTTPS logs exist but may not cover all avionics metadata.
stride.I_justification: Processed sensor frames contain classified ISR content.
stride.D_justification: Bandwidth saturation could delay mission data delivery.
stride.E_justification: Limited elevation path but gateway compromise possible.

threats.name: Sensor Frame Tampering
threats.description: Adversary alters decrypted ISR frames on the ground network to corrupt intelligence products.

mitigations_technical.title: Frame Integrity Hash Verification
mitigations_technical.description: Apply cryptographic hashes to sensor frames and verify at every hop on the ground network.

mitigations_administrative.title: Ground Network Integrity Monitoring
mitigations_administrative.description: Implement continuous network monitoring and anomaly alerting for frame tampering indicators.

stride.S_justification: Analyst workstation could be impersonated to inject tasks.
stride.T_justification: Waypoint updates can be tampered to alter flight path.
stride.D_justification: Denial prevents timely retasking of ISR mission.
stride.E_justification: Potential for privilege abuse via forged tasking.

threats.name: Tasking Injection
threats.description: Adversary impersonates analyst workstation to inject malicious waypoints or payload modes.

mitigations_technical.title: Tasking Digital Signature Validation
mitigations_technical.description: Require digital signatures on all tasking messages with strict certificate validation.

mitigations_administrative.title: Tasking Change Approval Workflow
mitigations_administrative.description: Enforce multi-party approval for all flight path and payload changes.

stride.S_justification: Maintenance test set can be spoofed on the bus.
stride.T_justification: BIT commands can be altered to trigger unsafe states.
stride.I_justification: Diagnostic data is sensitive but not classified.
stride.D_justification: Flooding bus prevents normal maintenance access.
stride.E_justification: Compromised session token may elevate maintenance rights.

threats.name: Malicious BIT Command
threats.description: Adversary injects forged BIT commands over the 1553 bus to induce unsafe LRU behavior.

mitigations_technical.title: BIT Command Whitelisting
mitigations_technical.description: Restrict 1553 bus to only pre-approved diagnostic command sets with hardware enforcement.

mitigations_administrative.title: Maintenance Session Authorization
mitigations_administrative.description: Require physical presence and authenticated token for any BIT command execution.

stride.S_justification: Telemetry router identity can be spoofed on bus.
stride.T_justification: Flight logs could be tampered during download.
stride.E_justification: No elevation path on diagnostic interface.

threats.name: HUMS Log Tampering
threats.description: Adversary modifies flight logs or fault codes during 1553 download to conceal incidents.

mitigations_technical.title: HUMS Data Signing
mitigations_technical.description: Sign all HUMS downloads with hardware-backed keys before transmission.

mitigations_administrative.title: HUMS Integrity Review
mitigations_administrative.description: Mandate post-download integrity checks by independent maintenance personnel.

stride.S_justification: Load manager can be impersonated on serial link.
stride.T_justification: Malicious software package injection risks flight safety.
stride.D_justification: Link denial blocks required software updates.
stride.E_justification: Successful load can grant elevated execution rights.

threats.name: Malicious Software Load
threats.description: Adversary supplies tampered software package over RS-422 to compromise flight control.

mitigations_technical.title: Secure Software Load Protocol
mitigations_technical.description: Use authenticated encryption and hardware root of trust for all software loads.

mitigations_administrative.title: Software Load Authorization
mitigations_administrative.description: Require cryptographic approval and physical key presence for load operations.

stride.S_justification: Gateway can be spoofed on LAN.
stride.T_justification: Signed package could be replaced before verification.
stride.R_justification: LAN logs may not capture signature checks.
stride.E_justification: Limited elevation but possible via malicious manifest.

threats.name: Software Package Substitution
threats.description: Adversary replaces signed package on the LAN before integrity verification.

mitigations_technical.title: Package Signature Verification
mitigations_technical.description: Perform mandatory signature verification before any package acceptance on LAN.

mitigations_administrative.title: Software Baseline Audit
mitigations_administrative.description: Conduct periodic audits of software distribution manifests and signatures.

stride.S_justification: Recorder identity can be spoofed on LAN.
stride.T_justification: Logs can be altered to hide maintenance events.
stride.I_justification: Maintenance logs contain fault and health data.
stride.E_justification: No privilege escalation path.

threats.name: Log Tampering on Sync
threats.description: Adversary alters maintenance logs during LAN synchronization to conceal tampering.

mitigations_technical.title: Log Integrity Hashing
mitigations_technical.description: Hash and sign all maintenance logs before synchronization.

mitigations_administrative.title: Log Review and Retention Policy
mitigations_administrative.description: Require independent review of synced logs and maintain immutable audit copies.

stride.S_justification: Key manager spoofing could distribute malicious keys.
stride.T_justification: Key material tampering breaks all link encryption.
stride.R_justification: Key rotation logs may be incomplete.
stride.D_justification: Key denial prevents secure link establishment.
stride.E_justification: Compromised keys enable elevated access to encrypted traffic.

threats.name: Key Material Spoofing
threats.description: Adversary distributes forged key material to break link encryption.

mitigations_technical.title: Hardware-Backed Key Distribution
mitigations_technical.description: Use hardware security modules for all key provisioning and rotation.

mitigations_administrative.title: Key Management Policy Enforcement
mitigations_administrative.description: Enforce strict key rotation schedules and revocation procedures with audit logging.

stride.S_justification: Internal UDP source can be spoofed within subsystem.
stride.T_justification: Position data susceptible to tampering on internal bus.
stride.R_justification: Minimal logging on internal navigation flow.
stride.D_justification: Loss of GPS feed degrades navigation accuracy.
stride.E_justification: No elevation path inside navigation subsystem.

threats.name: Internal GPS Spoofing
threats.description: Adversary spoofs GPS position data on internal UDP to corrupt navigation.

mitigations_technical.title: GPS Signal Authentication Filter
mitigations_technical.description: Apply RAIM and signal authentication within the navigation subsystem.

mitigations_administrative.title: Navigation Cross-Check Procedure
mitigations_administrative.description: Require periodic cross-check of GPS with IMU and other sensors.

stride.S_justification: SPI bus is internal and difficult to spoof.
stride.T_justification: Acceleration data can be altered on SPI.
stride.I_justification: IMU data is low sensitivity internally.
stride.D_justification: Loss of IMU feed impacts attitude control.
stride.E_justification: No privilege escalation possible.

threats.name: IMU Data Tampering
threats.description: Adversary tampers with IMU readings on SPI bus to degrade attitude control.

mitigations_technical.title: IMU Data Integrity Check
mitigations_technical.description: Implement CRC and range validation on IMU data reads.

mitigations_administrative.title: IMU Calibration Schedule
mitigations_administrative.description: Enforce regular IMU calibration and health monitoring procedures.

stride.S_justification: External GCS can be spoofed to inject commands.
stride.T_justification: Command messages can be tampered before validation.
stride.D_justification: Radio link denial prevents operator control.
stride.E_justification: Valid token can enable elevated command execution.

threats.name: External Command Injection
threats.description: Adversary spoofs GCS to inject malicious commands over TLS radio link.

mitigations_technical.title: External Link Command Authentication
mitigations_technical.description: Enforce mutual TLS with certificate pinning for GCS commands.

mitigations_administrative.title: GCS Operator Authentication Policy
mitigations_administrative.description: Require multi-factor authentication for all GCS operators.

stride.S_justification: Internal PCIe component hard to spoof.
stride.T_justification: Fused frames can be altered in memory transfer.
stride.I_justification: Fused sensor data is mission sensitive.
stride.E_justification: No elevation path on internal bus.

threats.name: Fusion Frame Tampering
threats.description: Adversary alters fused sensor frames in PCIe memory transfer to corrupt recording.

mitigations_technical.title: Memory Integrity Protection
mitigations_technical.description: Enable PCIe transaction signing and memory encryption for sensor frames.

mitigations_administrative.title: Frame Integrity Audit
mitigations_administrative.description: Perform periodic audits of fusion output integrity.

stride.S_justification: I2C internal link difficult to spoof.
stride.T_justification: Key responses can be tampered on I2C.
stride.E_justification: No elevation possible.

stride.S_justification: Remote ops endpoint can be impersonated.
stride.T_justification: Diagnostics report can be altered in transit.
stride.I_justification: Diagnostics reveal system health and faults.
stride.E_justification: Possible limited elevation via diagnostics interface.

threats.name: Remote Diagnostics Tampering
threats.description: Adversary alters remote diagnostics reports in transit to mask system faults.

mitigations_technical.title: Diagnostics Report Signing
mitigations_technical.description: Sign all remote diagnostics reports with device-specific keys.

mitigations_administrative.title: Remote Diagnostics Access Control
mitigations_administrative.description: Enforce strict access control lists and logging for remote diagnostics.

stride.S_justification: Internal bus allows limited spoofing of workstation.
stride.T_justification: BIT commands can be tampered before bus transfer.
stride.E_justification: Token may allow limited elevation.

threats.name: BIT Command Tampering
threats.description: Adversary tampers with BIT commands on internal bus to induce unsafe states.

mitigations_technical.title: Internal Bus Command Validation
mitigations_technical.description: Validate all BIT commands against a hardware-enforced whitelist.

mitigations_administrative.title: Maintenance Workstation Access Control
mitigations_administrative.description: Require physical token and role-based access for maintenance workstations.

stride.S_justification: Bus controller can be spoofed on 1553.
stride.T_justification: Altered BIT commands risk unsafe LRU states.
stride.E_justification: Compromised token can elevate maintenance privileges.

threats.name: Malicious 1553 BIT Command
threats.description: Adversary spoofs bus controller to send forged BIT commands risking unsafe LRU states.

mitigations_technical.title: 1553 Bus Controller Authentication
mitigations_technical.description: Enforce authenticated bus controller identity for all BIT commands.

mitigations_administrative.title: BIT Command Execution Logging
mitigations_administrative.description: Log and review all BIT commands with independent oversight.

stride.S_justification: Maintenance port can be spoofed.
stride.T_justification: Status responses can be falsified on bus.
stride.E_justification: No elevation path.

threats.name: Falsified LRU Status
threats.description: Adversary falsifies LRU status responses on 1553 bus to mask faults.

mitigations_technical.title: LRU Status Signing
mitigations_technical.description: Sign all LRU status responses with device-specific keys.

mitigations_administrative.title: LRU Status Verification Procedure
mitigations_administrative.description: Require cross-verification of status responses during maintenance.

stride.S_justification: Port can be impersonated.
stride.T_justification: HUMS data can be tampered during download.
stride.E_justification: No elevation path.

threats.name: HUMS Tampering on Bus
threats.description: Adversary tampers with HUMS data on 1553 during download to hide operational history.

mitigations_technical.title: HUMS Download Integrity Check
mitigations_technical.description: Apply cryptographic signatures to HUMS data before bus transfer.

mitigations_administrative.title: HUMS Download Review Protocol
mitigations_administrative.description: Require post-download review by maintenance supervisor.

stride.S_justification: Internal bus difficult to spoof.
stride.T_justification: HUMS can be altered on internal bus.
stride.E_justification: No elevation possible.

stride.S_justification: LAN source can be spoofed.
stride.T_justification: Signed package can be swapped before verification.
stride.R_justification: LAN logs may miss signature checks.
stride.E_justification: Manifest abuse may allow limited elevation.

threats.name: Signed Package Swap
threats.description: Adversary swaps signed software package on LAN before verification.

mitigations_technical.title: LAN Package Verification
mitigations_technical.description: Enforce mandatory signature verification on receipt from Bravo LAN.

mitigations_administrative.title: Software Package Approval Workflow
mitigations_administrative.description: Require approval workflow before accepting packages from Bravo.

stride.S_justification: Verification module can be spoofed on LAN.
stride.T_justification: Verification records can be falsified.
stride.E_justification: No elevation path.

stride.S_justification: Bus controller can be spoofed.
stride.T_justification: Malicious load injection risks flight safety.
stride.E_justification: Successful load grants elevated execution rights.

threats.name: Malicious 1553 Software Load
threats.description: Adversary spoofs bus controller to inject malicious software over 1553 risking flight safety.

mitigations_technical.title: 1553 Load Authentication
mitigations_technical.description: Authenticate all software loads over 1553 with hardware tokens.

mitigations_administrative.title: 1553 Load Authorization
mitigations_administrative.description: Require physical authorization and logging for all 1553 software loads.

interfaces.description: Software Load to Alpha via RS-422

stride.S_justification: Serial interface can be spoofed.
stride.T_justification: Package tampering on RS-422 risks safety.
stride.E_justification: Load grants elevated privileges.

threats.name: RS-422 Software Injection
threats.description: Adversary tampers with software package on RS-422 serial link to compromise avionics.

mitigations_technical.title: RS-422 Secure Load Protocol
mitigations_technical.description: Use authenticated encryption for all RS-422 software transfers.

mitigations_administrative.title: RS-422 Load Authorization
mitigations_administrative.description: Require dual authorization for RS-422 software loads.

interfaces.description: Maintenance Session Log Sync to Bravo

stride.S_justification: Recorder can be spoofed on LAN.
stride.T_justification: Session logs can be tampered.
stride.I_justification: Maintenance logs contain technician and fault data.
stride.E_justification: No elevation path.

threats.name: Maintenance Log Tampering
threats.description: Adversary tampers with maintenance session logs on LAN to conceal actions.

mitigations_technical.title: LAN Log Signing
mitigations_technical.description: Sign all maintenance logs before LAN synchronization.

mitigations_administrative.title: Maintenance Log Audit Policy
mitigations_administrative.description: Enforce independent audit of all synced maintenance logs.
